description:
Mozilla Firefox is free and open source software, built by a community of thousands from all over the world.

Firefox Browser, also known as Mozilla Firefox or simply Firefox, is a free and open-source web browser developed by the Mozilla Foundation and its subsidiary, the Mozilla Corporation. Firefox uses the Gecko layout engine to render web pages, which implements current and anticipated web standards. In 2017, Firefox began incorporating new technology under the code name Quantum to promote parallelism and a more intuitive user interface. Firefox is officially available for Windows 7 or newer, macOS, and Linux. Its unofficial ports are available for various Unix and Unix-like operating systems including FreeBSD, OpenBSD, NetBSD, illumos, and Solaris Unix.
Version 160.0.1, first offered to Release channel users on November 17, 2026

Fixed
- Fixed thin lines in PDFs printing as thick black boxes on some printers on Windows. (Bug 2091728)
- Fixed PDFs, web page graphics, and WebGL content appearing blank or broken on Macs with AMD graphics, such as black cells in Google Sheets. (Bug 2091596)
- Fixed incorrect colors in WebGL and canvas content, such as games and Google Meet backgrounds, on some Linux systems using Wayland. (Bug 2089043)
- Fixed links on some sites, such as the Google Store, taking a very long time to load. (Bug 2087787)
- Fixed tabs crashing on some sites, most notably ChatGPT. (Bug 2088486)
- Fixed WebTransport connections being unable to send datagrams after a site sent many in quick succession. (Bug 2092532)
- Fixed trackpad and mouse swipes sometimes scrolling the page when a site had blocked scrolling. (Bug 2086786)
- Reference link to 160.0 release notes.
